name: 05-layouts
description: Where the lights physically are: compiled layouts for the common shapes, and scripted ones for anything else.

steps.title: Layouts
steps.caption: Layouts. Where the lights are.
A layout says where the lights are. Whatever shape it makes, the effect paints into it.
Here is a grid, sixteen by sixteen. Two hundred and fifty six lights, addressed by row and column.
The size is just a control, so I can grow it while it runs. Width first, to two hundred and fifty six.
And the height to match. Sixty five thousand lights now, and the effect never noticed the change.
To show you another shape I take this one out first, so only one layout is on screen at a time.
A ring. The lights sit around a circle now, and the same effect follows them without being told.
A ring counts lights rather than rows, so this one goes to two hundred and forty around the circle.
Out it goes again. Every layout is a module, so adding and removing one is the same gesture throughout.
A spiral, winding outward from the middle. I did not rewrite a single effect for it.
Nine hundred lights along the spiral, and it winds further out to hold them.
And again, to make room. This is the whole point of keeping layout and effect apart.
A cube. This one is three dimensional, so a three D effect fills its volume rather than a face.
A cube sizes on three axes. Twenty four wide, and the other two follow in a moment.
Twenty four high.
And twenty four deep: nearly fourteen thousand lights in a solid block.
Clearing once more. On a real installation you would leave one of these in place, matched to your lights.
Tubes: one column of lights each, standing side by side, the way many real installations are built.
Twenty four tubes now, each still its own column.
One last time. Everything so far ships compiled into the firmware, ready to pick from a list.
But when the list does not have your shape, you write it yourself. This script runs on the device.
This is a rose curve, written in MoonLive and compiled on the device itself while you watch.
And sixteen rings on a wall, from the same twenty lines. One effect, every shape.
